description: Welcome to 363 Headlands Court -- where breathtaking natural beauty meets everyday convenience in one of Sausalito's most sought-after communities. This light-filled 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers a thoughtfully designed floor plan with effortless flow from the updated kitchen with hillside views through the dining area to an inviting living space with wood floors. The living room opens directly onto a private view patio, ideal for indoor/outdoor living, entertaining, or simply unwinding at the end of the day. The primary suite captures sweeping water views, creating a truly peaceful retreat, while the second bedroom and front entry frame scenic Mt. Tamalpais and rolling hillside vistas. Water and mountain views from a single address -- it's the best of Marin at your doorstep. Updates include new carpet, a remodeled kitchen, and a refreshed primary bathroom, making this a genuinely move-in ready home. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, fireplace, one-car parking in a shared garage, and a partially finished attic for additional storage. Perfectly positioned for easy access to Highway 101, San Francisco, and miles of world-class hiking and biking trails, 363 Headlands Court offers a rare combination of natural serenity, modern comfort, and unbeatable convenience.
